thesis: The page is a walk along a row of Charleston facades: each section is a house front drawn in SVG, painted in its historic color, carrying a small plaque that names the street feeling, the salt-or-sun enemy, and the service that fits.

signature.name: Facade + Plaque
signature.summary: A simplified Charleston house silhouette with a fill color set via CSS custom property, and a small rectangular plaque beneath it containing street-feeling, enemy, and service lines in mono accent type. Reused across hero filmstrip, four story sections, and footer rule.

motion.intro: Shutters swing open (rotateY -90→0, 800ms) to reveal headline; filmstrip drift begins after.
stories: facade slides in from right on section enter (translateX 100%→0, 900ms)
porch ceiling glows haint blue when section centers (opacity 0→1, 600ms)
motion.hover: Hairline under links/buttons grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms
